cat <<'EOF' > /tmp/edge.py
import json
from rest_api import RestAPI

db = {"users": [
    {"name": "Adam", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Bob", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
    {"name": "Chuck", "owes": {}, "owed_by": {}, "balance": 0.0},
]}
api = RestAPI(db)
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 5.25})))
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 0.25})))
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Chuck", "amount": 2.0})))
print(api.get("/users"))
print(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Chuck", "Adam"]})))
# sequential netting to zero then re-lending
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Bob", "borrower": "Adam", "amount": 5.5})))
print(api.post("/iou", json.dumps({"lender": "Adam", "borrower": "Bob", "amount": 1.0})))
# zero balance formatting check
r = json.loads(api.get("/users"))
assert all(u["balance"] != -0.0 or str(u["balance"]) == "0.0" for u in r["users"])
assert isinstance(r["users"][0]["balance"], float)
# filter sorting
r = json.loads(api.get("/users", json.dumps({"users": ["Chuck", "Adam"]})))
assert [u["name"] for u in r["users"]] == ["Adam", "Chuck"], r
print("EDGE OK")
EOF
